headline: Stray Kids ring in 2027 with Gocheok Sky Dome shows
sub: 'RUN IT SEOUL SPECIAL' set for Jan 1–2 in Seoul

points.title: What to know
items: A special stop on the 'RUN IT' world tour
Their July–Aug KSPO DOME shows all sold out
Poster revealed on official SNS on Nov 24
More ticket details coming via official SNS

source: Source: Stray Kids official SNS, via Korean media
caption:
Stray Kids will kick off 2027 with STAY at Seoul's Gocheok Sky Dome!

The group announced 'RUN IT SEOUL SPECIAL,' a special show of their 'RUN IT' world tour, set for Jan 1 and 2, 2027. Fan club presale runs Dec 7–8, with general sale on Dec 9. Their five KSPO DOME shows in July and August sold out, so get ready.

📌 Source: Stray Kids official SNS, via Korean media (Etoday, MK Sports)
